draft.body:
My name is Justin Mascarenhas. I recently came across ELYONs Embedded Software Development Engineer role in Murrysville, PA and am reaching out given your HR oversight at ELYON.

I completed my M.S. in Computer Engineering at RIT in May 2026. On the technical side, I have built bare-metal firmware on STM32 in C, worked with FreeRTOS for real-time task scheduling, implemented UART/I2C/SPI drivers, and debugged hardware with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers across multiple embedded systems projects and internships.

The posted role specifies prior industry experience I am still building, so I wanted to ask whether ELYON has any embedded or firmware engineering openings suited to a strong new-grad - or whether there is appetite to consider my profile for the current role. I am available to start within 4 weeks and am open to location.

I would be glad to share my resume if helpful.
draft.hook_used: HR manager - framed as pipeline inquiry with resume offer
